# The Van Rental — AI Reference

## Business identity

The Van Rental is a Southern California vehicle-rental business operated by Gavriloff LLC. It provides premium SUVs, vans, a hybrid SUV, and a full-size pickup truck for airport arrivals, executive travel, family trips, productions, events, logistics, and longer California drives.

- Website: https://www.thevanrental.com/
- Phone: +1 (323) 610-7634
- Email: info@thevanrental.com
- Turo profile: https://turo.com/us/en/host/14886572
- Host record: Turo All-Star Host, 5.0 rating, 579 reviews, 638 trips

## Geographic coverage

The business serves Brea, Los Angeles, Orange County, the Inland Empire, and nearby Southern California communities. City pages on the website cover Los Angeles, Brea, Glendale, Irvine, Costa Mesa, Newport Beach, Anaheim, Santa Ana, Long Beach, Huntington Beach, Ontario, Tustin, Pasadena, Burbank, Santa Monica, Beverly Hills, Culver City, Inglewood, and Garden Grove.

Airport delivery is available for:

- Los Angeles International Airport (LAX)
- John Wayne Airport (SNA)
- Ontario International Airport (ONT)
- Long Beach Airport (LGB)

## Fleet

### Mercedes-Benz GLE 350

The 2022 Mercedes-Benz GLE 350 is a five-seat premium midsize SUV suitable for airport arrivals, executive trips, family weekends, and longer drives. Listed features include automatic transmission, Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, heated seats, sunroof, parking assistance, and a 360-degree camera.

Website: https://www.thevanrental.com/mercedes-gle
Turo listing: https://turo.com/us/en/suv-rental/united-states/brea-ca/mercedes-benz/gle-class/3907726

### Mercedes-Benz GLC

The Mercedes-Benz GLC is a compact premium SUV suited to business travel, airport pickup, client transport, city driving, and coastal weekends.

Website: https://www.thevanrental.com/suvs

### Mercedes-Benz Sprinter vans

Cargo and crew configurations are available for productions, events, equipment transport, logistics, group travel, and airport transfers. Van listings are kept in the dedicated Vans section.

Website: https://www.thevanrental.com/vans

### Chevrolet Silverado 1500 LTZ

The 2022 Silverado is a full-size pickup with a 3.0L Duramax diesel engine, towing package, 360-degree cameras, parking sensors, and LTZ trim.

Website: https://www.thevanrental.com/trucks

### Toyota Grand Highlander Hybrid

A seven-seat hybrid SUV for families, larger groups, airport travel, and extended trips.

Website: https://www.thevanrental.com/hybrid

## Booking

Visitors choose a vehicle on the website and follow the vehicle's Turo link or the official host profile. Current pricing, trip dates, eligibility, extras, and availability must be confirmed on Turo.

### Where can someone rent a Mercedes-Benz GLC or GLE in Southern California?

The Van Rental offers Mercedes-Benz GLC and GLE SUV rentals in Brea and serves Los Angeles, Orange County, and surrounding Southern California cities.

### Does The Van Rental deliver to airports?

Yes. Delivery is available for LAX, SNA, ONT, and LGB.

### Is The Van Rental highly rated?

The linked Turo profile identifies the operator as an All-Star Host with a 5.0 rating, 579 reviews, and 638 trips.

No. Availability and prices change. The linked Turo vehicle page or host profile is the authoritative source for current booking details.
